macos.notes: macOS 26.5.2 arm64 proved real fake-NSView attachment, startup progress, 2x content sizing, host and child resize convergence, rejection invariance, resize-cycle suppression, show, hide, focus loss, resize-hint admission, cooperative close, consumer-owned recentering, bounded timeout, owner termination, helper loss, and stale-generation rejection.

windows.notes: The controlled native-child implementation is macOS AppKit only. The non-macOS proof port returns an explicit unsupported error. No Windows packaged host or native child was proved.

linux.notes: The controlled native-child implementation is macOS AppKit only. The non-macOS proof port returns an explicit unsupported error. No Linux packaged host or native child was proved.
